_comment: MODEL assumptions about how hard it is to move between organisations.
Deliberately separate from world-model.json: that file describes the world
(who exists, where they are, how deep each market is), this file describes
the model laid over it. Nothing here is measured — every number is a tunable
assumption, and the affinity tiers in particular have no observational
backing in the dataset (there are only 5 talent-flow edges in world-model.json,
far too few to fit against). See world-model-plan.md sections 3 and 7.
Composition:  a(i->j) = geo(i,j) * sector(i,j) * gradient(i->j) * bonus(i,j)
capped at 1.0. Multiplicative, so 'cross-country AND cross-sector is harder
still' falls out without a special case.

geoTiers._comment: Symmetric. Evaluated most-favourable-first; multi-site organisations take the MINIMUM cost across all their site pairs, so two global banks sharing any city count as sameCity.

sectorTiers._comment: Symmetric. sameFamily captures that IB -> Elite Boutique is a much smaller step than IB -> Insurance.

sectorFamilies._comment: Groups the 14 Sector nodes. Keyed by Sector node_id so a renamed label doesn't silently break the mapping.

_comment: Which geoTier applies to a cross-country move, by bloc pair. 'same' is
implicit (sameBloc tier). Only pairs listed as 'adjacent' get adjacentBloc;
everything else falls through to distantBloc.
ANGLO groups by shared language, common-law tradition and mutual
qualification recognition — it deliberately cuts ACROSS the geographic
region hierarchy, which is why it cannot be derived from PART_OF.
Asymmetry. gradient(i->j) = min(1, (w_j / w_i) ^ gamma) where w is the
market_index on the destination/origin location. Moving UP the economic
gradient costs nothing extra; moving DOWN is penalised — people do not
tend to move against the flow of money. gamma scales how strongly.
gamma = 0 disables asymmetry entirely (every gradient term becomes 1.0).
Multipliers for the irreducible organisation-to-organisation relations in
world-model.json — the facts no attribute can reconstruct. PARENT_OF is
rated higher than COMPETES_FOR_TALENT because an intra-group transfer
typically bypasses the visa and qualification frictions that make an
external cross-border move rare. Result is capped at a <= 1.0.
PLACES_GRADUATES_IN / OFFSHORE_RECRUITS_FOR are annotation only (5 records
total) and are not used.
